input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: The structure of Section 21 is otherwise good: the cap is expressly mutual, indirect/consequential damages are mutually excluded (21.2), the Excluded Claims set in 21.3 covers confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and the other Party's IP, and Customer's payment obligation is carved out of "damages". The failure is the cap quantum: it is measured by "Fees", which Section 1.5 defines as only the "Implementation Fee", i.e. the one-time USD 12,000 charge in the first Order Form (Section 1.6), and is further narrowed to the first Order Form. Recurring subscription and service charges are therefore excluded, making the cap illusory at roughly USD 12,000 — far below the fallback of twelve months' fees and inside walk-away territory (cap below six months' fees). Minimal redline changes only the cap base in 21.1 to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000; the existing carve-outs are left untouched.

proposal.summary: Replace the illusory cap base (Fees = USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form) with the greater of 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and USD 1,000,000.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the cap is measured by "Fees", which Section 1.5 defines as only the USD 12,000 one-time Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is effectively USD 12,000 and far below our floor of twelve months' charges. We have moved the cap to the greater of all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000; the Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement) remain outside the cap as already drafted.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
